producthunt.name: Prefactor
producthunt.tagline: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
producthunt.description: Most agents pass their evals and fail in production. Prefactor is the evaluation layer that closes the gap. We score every agent run in real time, surface quality regressions and drift as they happen, and show engineering teams exactly how their agents are performing at scale. Built for the teams shipping agents to customers.

producthunt.name: Cekura
producthunt.tagline: The self-improvement loop for voice agents
producthunt.description: Cekura is the testing, observability, and self-improvement platform for production voice and chat AI agents. It simulates thousands of scenarios, catches failures, diagnoses the root cause, rewrites prompts and config, then re-validates with a full regression sweep. Unlike tools that hand failures back to your team, Cekura closes the loop by fixing the agent itself and proving the fix holds without overfitting.
